name: nutria
description: Tooling transversal de NutrIA. Todo (tests, migraciones, seed) corre dentro de los contenedores Docker de cada repo, nunca con el runtime del host. Ver README.md.

scripts.test:backend: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps backend npm run test
scripts.test:backend:integration: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps backend npm run test:integration
scripts.test:backend:coverage: node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); fs.rmSync('nutria-backend/coverage', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('nutria-backend/coverage', { recursive: true })" && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps -v ./nutria-backend/coverage:/app/coverage backend npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:frontend: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps frontend npm test --if-present
scripts.contract:ia:update: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps -v ./nutria-ia/contracts:/app/contracts -v ./nutria-backend/src/schemas/fixtures:/backend-contract ia-test python -m scripts.export_openapi /app/contracts/openapi.json /backend-contract/ia.openapi.json
scripts.db:migrate: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps backend npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.db:migrate:dev: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps -v ./nutria-backend/prisma:/app/prisma backend npx prisma migrate dev
scripts.db:seed: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps backend npm run seed
scripts.db:create-admin: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps backend npm run create-admin
scripts.db:reset: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps backend npx prisma migrate reset --force
scripts.db:studio: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml up -d --wait postgres && docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml run --build --rm --no-deps -p 5555:5555 backend npx prisma studio --hostname 0.0.0.0 --browser none
scripts.shell:backend: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml exec backend sh
scripts.shell:ia: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml exec ia sh
scripts.shell:frontend: docker compose -f nutria-backend/docker-compose.yml exec frontend sh
